name: cc-executor-subagents
description: Fast multi-agent executor for Claude Code. Splits quick repo tasks into independent slices, supports pre-defined plan execution with Codex high plan-vs-output review, uses AGY 3.6.0+ for front-end and large-context work, keeps Codex for backend, tests, and review, and reports without OpenSpec ceremony.

plugins.name: cc-executor-subagents
plugins.description: Executor skill + /executor slash command for quick multi-agent implementation. Runs a light preflight with a configurable Project_Config-derived stack, follows pre-defined plans when provided, routes front-end and image work to AGY's antigravity-coder (write) with antigravity-agent reserved for read-only analysis/review, keeps Codex on backend, tests, and review, then integrates and verifies without OpenSpec ceremony.
